editorial:
Imagine living in a world that is just one giant tree stretching up into the clouds. That is where you meet Kaena, a spunky teenager who does not fit in with her strict community. While everyone else follows the rules and fears the unknown, Kaena feels a weird pull toward the top of the tree. She decides to break every law her people have to climb the Axis and find out what is actually waiting for her at the peak. The vibe is a mix of a fantasy quest and a coming-of-age story, making you feel the same curiosity and nervousness that she does as she climbs higher.

You will notice that the world-building is the best part here, though the animation can look a bit dated since it came out in 2003. The pacing stays steady, and the mystery of the clouds keeps you guessing. If you like stories about brave girls fighting against a system, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the top of the tree, you discover that the world is actually a giant space station. The High Priest was lying to everyone to keep them trapped and scared. Kaena finds a way to wake up the station's computer and opens a portal to the real world. She saves her people from their fake reality and leads them toward a new beginning, proving that curiosity is better than blind faith.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves unique fantasy worlds and brave protagonists.
